about: The correction in hand (src/core/hand.ts): event sequences with every timer come round, what a commit of each group makes of a cook before and after the pull, the cook the aimed-for egg is planned on, and the start's − and + to each limit. Generated by tools/fixtures/hand.ts (npm run fixtures): do not hand-edit.

sequences.note: a long press on a radio: Room tapped, then Custom held; the web sees the fingers, and the lift of a press that changed nothing settles
a long press on a radio, as iOS's picker reports it: two changes, no finger
a size, then a weight: the menu and the field are both the egg's mass, one commit
a size, then a weight, as iOS sends it: the picker and the typing report no finger
the room from the "from" panel, then from Settings: one group, one commit
left inside a settle (the page hidden, or Control Centre pulled down): committed then, and a change after it is a new one
left with a finger on the slider: committed, the press gone with the page, and the aimed-for egg let go after its hold
a − or + tapped, then the thermometer's reading touched: another control, committed at once
a − or + tapped, then a Settings switch: another control, committed at once
the buttons and the clauses: each commits what is in hand before it acts, and nothing when nothing is
two groups by the keyboard, no finger: the first commits as it was when the second's change comes, and the second settles
a finger on another group commits the change in hand
a drag of the slider: planned once a burst in, committed on the lift, the aimed-for egg let go a settle after the last change
the slider touched and lifted without moving: nothing in hand, nothing committed
a − or + held until it repeats: committed on the lift
a − or + tapped twice inside a settle: one commit, a settle after the second lift
the hold set again on a lift with nothing in hand: a finger down past the hold keeps the aimed-for egg until it lifts
the controls drawn afresh inside a settle: everything in hand dropped, every timer cancelled
the start's − tapped, then held: committed on the lift
